# 5. DGIST

## A. University snapshot

| Field | Verified answer |
|---|---|
| University | Daegu Gyeongbuk Institute of Science and Technology (DGIST) |
| Country / city / campus | Republic of Korea · Daegu · DGIST campus |
| Type | Public STEM/research institute |
| Fall 2027 status | **CONFIRMED FOR FALL 2027** |
| Platform | **Study in Korea** |
| Application URL | [Official application process](https://www.dgist.ac.kr/iuadm/sub02_03.do) |
| Best programme | Undergraduate Studies → **Computer Science and Engineering track** |
| Degree / language | Bachelor’s; basic and major courses taught in English, with some general electives in Korean/English |
| Major structure | Broad first-year study followed by track selection; current guide describes flexible major/minor pathways |
| Intake/selectivity | No predetermined international quota or nationality quota published |

## Changes since 13 Sep 2026

- **Correction:** the official application system is **Study in Korea**, not DGIST’s own portal.
- **Correction/clarification:** English scores, standardized academic tests and one recommendation are **optional**, although DGIST strongly recommends useful academic evidence.
- Exact opening/closing times, fee, document list and scholarship conditions are now confirmed from current official materials.
- Exact online recommendation questions and any application text prompts remain unavailable until the cycle opens.

## B. Programmes

| Official route | Degree/unit | Structure and prerequisites | Restrictions |
|---|---|---|---|
| Computer Science and Engineering track | Bachelor’s, School/College of Undergraduate Studies | Broad science/engineering foundation; track work spans CS, AI, computing and related engineering. No applicant-level programming, calculus or physics minimum is published. | Not a direct CS admission; track is selected after entry. No international or female restriction published. |
| Electronics Engineering track | Bachelor’s | Relevant for computer engineering, devices and embedded systems | Secondary fit |

Current undergraduate materials describe a **single-major system**, with a major recognized after 27 credits and a minor after 18; a double-major route may be possible within graduation-credit rules. The page does not advertise a separate undergraduate BS in Artificial Intelligence; AI appears as a field within computing/electrical study.

**Best programme for me:** Computer Science and Engineering track. Electronics Engineering is useful only for a stronger hardware/embedded focus.

## C. Application rounds and deadlines

| Event | Date/time | Zone | Confirmed? | What must be ready |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Application opens | 2 Dec 2026, 10:00 | KST | Yes | Study in Korea account and core documents |
| Application + document deadline | **28 Jan 2027, 18:00** | KST | Yes | One combined PDF ≤10 MB plus paid/submitted form |
| Recommendation | By application deadline | KST | Yes | Optional one, direct recommender submission |
| Evaluation / possible interview | Through Apr 2027 | — | Partial | Monitor email/portal |
| Acceptance/enrolment | By **11 May 2027** | — | Yes | Follow offer instructions |
| Final diploma/apostille | After admission, exact date announced | — | TBA | Final NIS records |
| Semester starts | Late Aug / early Sep 2027 | — | Partial | Visa/housing/orientation |

There is one application round; it is not described as binding. DGIST warns against multiple enrolment at Korean universities, and admission deferral is not available under the guide.

### My recommended timeline

- Choose recommender by **1 November**; request letter by **15 November**.
- Request NIS transcript, grading scale, school profile and expected-graduation letter by **20 November**.
- Build Study in Korea account and inspect the live recommendation process on **2 December**.
- Final optional test/award selection by **20 December**; do not upload weak or unverifiable material.
- Order any official test verification by **5 January** if the live form requires it.
- Final PDF audit by **12 January**; target submission **15–18 January**; recommender target **15 January**.

## D. Platform and fee

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Platform | Study in Korea; upload one English PDF, maximum 10 MB |
| Programme choices | Admission to DGIST undergraduate programme; no direct CS choice |
| Editing after submission | Generally not permitted except through a formal request; finalize before submitting |
| Fee | **KRW 50,000** |
| Refund / waiver | Non-refundable; no waiver |
| Exam/scholarship fee | None published |
| Initial mailing | No initial paper mailing stated; uploads first |

## E. Document checklist

| Document | Required? | Who submits | When / format | Notes |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Study in Korea application | R | Applicant | By 28 Jan, 18:00 KST | Finalize before submission |
| Passport/ID | R | Applicant | Scan in combined PDF | Applicant nationality |
| Both parents’ passports/ID | R | Applicant | Scan | Nationality evidence |
| Family relationship/birth certificate | R | Applicant | Official English or notarized English translation | Must connect applicant/parents |
| High-school transcript, all available years | R | Applicant uploads official school record | Through first semester of final year plus current coursework | Include grading scale |
| Expected graduation or enrolment letter | R if final diploma unavailable | Applicant from school | Official document showing graduation date | Final diploma after admission |
| Final NIS certificate/transcript | POST | Applicant/school | Deadline announced after offer | Apostille/legalization instructions TBA |
| School profile | O / REC | Applicant | ≤5 pages | Useful for NIS |
| Standardized academic test | O / REC | Applicant | Upload evidence | SAT/AP/IB/A-level/ACT, international olympiad, or relevant national leaving/entrance test |
| English test | O / REC | Applicant | Valid test record | No published minimum |
| Recommendation | O, max 1 | Recommender | Direct online submission | Academic personnel only |
| Awards | O | Applicant | Up to 5 | Strongest only |
| Activities/CV/GitHub/portfolio | No separate item published | Applicant only if live form permits | — | Not a required substitute |
| Essays/personal statement | Not listed | — | — | Exact live-form fields TBA |
| Medical/insurance/visa evidence | POST | Applicant | After offer | Offer instructions |

Non-English material needs a notarized English translation. Late documents are not accepted under the current guide.

## F. NIS route

- No named NIS or Kazakhstan Attestat route and no NIS Higher Level minimum are published.
- An expected-graduation certificate is expressly accepted; the transcript may omit unavailable final second-semester grades.
- IB/A-level predicted results are expressly accepted as optional test evidence. The guide does not expressly extend that wording to predicted NIS results.
- The NIS final certificate should be submitted after admission, but the exact apostille deadline is **TBA**. June release appears workable in principle; written confirmation is needed.
- English testing is optional, so an NIS MOI waiver is not necessary for application. A strong IELTS score may still reduce uncertainty and strengthen academic readiness evidence.

## G. Academic requirements and tests

### Official minimum

Meet the international citizenship rule and graduate from high school in time for Fall 2027. No GPA, NIS grade, subject, SAT or English-score minimum is published.

### Competitive target — analysis

DGIST’s holistic review rewards strong Math/science records and evidence of technical potential. No official competitive range is published. SAT 1300–1350 plus IELTS 7.0–7.5 can be useful but is neither required nor a funding threshold.

| Test | Rule |
|---|---|
| SAT / ACT / AP | Optional; no minimum, superscore or current reporting code published in the guide |
| IB / A-level | Optional; predicted results accepted |
| National exam | Optional if relevant to graduation/admission; explain unfamiliar system |
| IELTS / TOEFL iBT | Optional; no minimum |
| TEPS / TOEIC | Optional; accepted |
| Cambridge CAE/CPE, PTE Academic, Duolingo | Optional; accepted |
| Validity | English evidence within two years under guide terms |
| TOPIK | Not required for English-medium academic route |

The public guide does not require official College Board/IELTS agency transmission; it lists document upload. The live portal and later verification request control. Agency sending fees, if requested, are paid separately to the provider.

## H. Interview / exam

No routine internal Math, Physics, Chemistry, programming or placement exam is published for admission. DGIST may invite selected applicants to an interview; it is mandatory only if invited. Exact format, subjects, duration and weighting are not officially published.

## I. Recommendation

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Number | 0 required; **one optional maximum** |
| Who | Academic adviser, school teacher, principal, university counselor or other academic personnel |
| Submission | Direct online recommender submission; Korean or English |
| Required identification | Name, position, affiliation, relationship and contact details |
| Exact ratings/questions/limits | **Not publicly published** as of 4 Oct; DGIST says detailed process will appear when the cycle starts |

**My strategy:** use one Math, CS or Physics teacher who can give concrete evidence of problem-solving, initiative and classroom/research performance. Counselor context belongs in the school profile unless the counselor directly taught or supervised substantial work.

## J. Essays

| Essay | Prompt | Limit | Status |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Personal statement / study plan | Not listed in the current public required-document list | — | Not officially published |
| Scholarship essay | None | — | Scholarship consideration is not shown as a separate application |

Inspect the live Study in Korea form on 2 December for text boxes. Do not invent prompts now.

## K. Scholarships and aid

Source: [official undergraduate scholarship page](https://www.dgist.ac.kr/iuadm/sub04_01.do).

| Category | Award | Separate application? | Rule |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Automatic tuition | DGIST international undergraduate tuition support | No | Full tuition, maximum 8 semesters; current page states no GPA condition |
| Living support route 1 | Financial Aid | No separate admission form published | KRW 328,500/month during regular semesters; ≥10 credits, no disciplinary/probation status |
| Living support route 2 | DGISTep | No separate admission form published | KRW 330,000/month including vacations; ≥10 credits, no probation |
| High-achievement award | DGISTep-S | Internal selection | KRW 1.5m/semester; not first semester; freshman GPA >3.7/4.3 or sophomore+ >4.0 plus ≥15 credits |
| Settlement | International settlement allowance | No | KRW 500,000 once |
| Need-based/government | No additional applicant-level scheme confirmed | — | Do not assume |

Financial Aid and DGISTep are presented as different support types; do **not** add both monthly figures unless DGIST confirms stacking.

### Coverage and renewal

| Cost | Covered? | Rule |
|---|---:|---|
| Tuition | Yes | Full waiver up to 8 semesters |
| Housing | No | Student pays |
| Meals | Not separately guaranteed | Paid from allowance/personal funds |
| Monthly living | Yes, assigned support type | KRW 328,500 or 330,000 under current categories |
| Settlement | Yes | KRW 500k once |
| Books / visa / flight / transport / laptop | Not published as covered | Personal cost |
| Health insurance | Current international support page should control at enrolment | Exact 2027 amount/coverage TBA |

An exact annual gap cannot be calculated because current official admissions pages do not publish a complete Fall 2027 cost of attendance or guaranteed dorm rate. [Housing page](https://www.dgist.ac.kr/iuadm/sub04_03.do) confirms dorm availability but says accommodation is paid individually; it does not give a four-year guarantee on the reviewed page.

## L. After admission

Accept/enrol by the offer deadline; submit final NIS certificate/transcript and authentication requested by DGIST; provide any original test evidence; arrange visa, financial proof, insurance and paid dormitory; complete arrival/orientation. Exact diploma/apostille, housing and visa dates remain offer-specific/TBA.

## M. Strategic assessment — analysis

- **Admission difficulty:** Reach / competitive.
- **Full-funding difficulty:** Closely tied to admission; tuition is strong and automatic, but the package is not full cost of attendance because housing/meals can exceed the allowance.
- **Fit:** Strong for flexible CS/AI exploration and research.

## N. Still TBA / needs confirmation

Exact online recommendation questions; any live-form essay fields; whether NIS results count as an optional national examination; agency-report requirement/codes; interview format; final certificate/apostille deadline; exact housing allocation/rate; insurance coverage; whether living-support categories stack or are alternatives.

## O. Email question

> I am a Grade 12 applicant from Nazarbayev Intellectual School in Kazakhstan. My final NIS Certificate will be issued in June 2027. May I apply with an official expected-graduation letter, current transcript and NIS predicted grades, then submit the final apostilled certificate after admission? What is the exact final-document deadline, and may the NIS Certificate be submitted as optional national school-leaving examination evidence?

Order any official test verification by.ru: Заказать официальную проверку результатов к **5 января**, если действующая форма требует её.
Order any official test verification by.en: Order any official test verification by **5 January** if the live form requires it.

Final PDF audit by **12 January**; targe.ru: Проверить итоговый PDF к **12 января**; личная цель подачи **15–18 января**, письма — **15 января**.
Final PDF audit by **12 January**; targe.en: Final PDF audit by **12 January**; target submission **15–18 January**; recommender target **15 January**.

Study in Korea; upload one English PDF,.ru: Study in Korea; один PDF на английском, максимум 10 MB
Study in Korea; upload one English PDF,.en: Study in Korea; upload one English PDF, maximum 10 MB

Admission to DGIST undergraduate program.ru: Поступление на общий бакалавриат DGIST, не прямой выбор CS
Admission to DGIST undergraduate program.en: Admission to DGIST undergraduate programme; no direct CS choice

Generally not permitted except through a.ru: Обычно не разрешено без официального запроса; завершите всё до отправки
Generally not permitted except through a.en: Generally not permitted except through a formal request; finalize before submitting

No initial paper mailing stated; uploads.ru: Первоначальная отправка бумажных документов не указана; сначала загрузка
No initial paper mailing stated; uploads.en: No initial paper mailing stated; uploads first

Non-English material needs a notarized E.ru: Неанглийские материалы требуют нотариально заверенного перевода на английский. По текущему руководству поздние документы не принимаются.
Non-English material needs a notarized E.en: Non-English material needs a notarized English translation. Late documents are not accepted under the current guide.

Official English or notarized English tr.ru: Официальный английский документ или нотариально заверенный перевод
Official English or notarized English tr.en: Official English or notarized English translation

High-school transcript, all available ye.ru: Транскрипт старшей школы за все доступные годы

Through first semester of final year plu.ru: До первого семестра выпускного года включительно плюс текущие предметы
Through first semester of final year plu.en: Through first semester of final year plus current coursework

Expected graduation or enrolment letter.ru: Письмо об ожидаемом выпуске или обучении

R if final diploma unavailable.ru: R — если итоговый диплом пока недоступен

Apostille/legalization instructions TBA.ru: Инструкции апостиля / легализации пока не опубликованы

SAT/AP/IB/A-level/ACT, international oly.ru: SAT/AP/IB/A-level/ACT, международная олимпиада или подходящий национальный выпускной / вступительный тест
SAT/AP/IB/A-level/ACT, international oly.en: SAT/AP/IB/A-level/ACT, international olympiad, or relevant national leaving/entrance test

Applicant only if live form permits.ru: Заявительница — только если действующая форма позволяет
Applicant only if live form permits.en: Applicant only if live form permits

Exact live-form fields TBA.ru: Точные поля действующей формы пока не опубликованы

No named NIS or Kazakhstan Attestat rout.ru: Отдельный путь NIS или казахстанского Attestat и минимум NIS Higher Level не опубликованы.
No named NIS or Kazakhstan Attestat rout.en: No named NIS or Kazakhstan Attestat route and no NIS Higher Level minimum are published.

An expected-graduation certificate is ex.ru: Подтверждение ожидаемого выпуска прямо принимается; в транскрипте можно не указывать недоступные итоговые оценки второго семестра.
An expected-graduation certificate is ex.en: An expected-graduation certificate is expressly accepted; the transcript may omit unavailable final second-semester grades.

IB/A-level predicted results are express.ru: Прогнозные IB/A-level прямо принимаются как необязательные результаты тестов. Руководство не распространяет эту формулировку прямо на прогнозные NIS.
IB/A-level predicted results are express.en: IB/A-level predicted results are expressly accepted as optional test evidence. The guide does not expressly extend that wording to predicted NIS results.

The NIS final certificate should be subm.ru: Итоговый сертификат NIS предоставляется после поступления, но точный срок апостиля — **TBA**. Выпуск в июне выглядит совместимым в принципе; нужно письменное подтверждение.
The NIS final certificate should be subm.en: The NIS final certificate should be submitted after admission, but the exact apostille deadline is **TBA**. June release appears workable in principle; written confirmation is needed.

English testing is optional, so an NIS M.ru: Английский тест необязателен, поэтому для подачи не нужно освобождение NIS по MOI. Сильный IELTS всё же помогает уменьшить неопределённость и показать готовность к учёбе.
English testing is optional, so an NIS M.en: English testing is optional, so an NIS MOI waiver is not necessary for application. A strong IELTS score may still reduce uncertainty and strengthen academic readiness evidence.

Meet the international citizenship rule.ru: Соответствовать правилам международного гражданства и окончить школу к Fall 2027. Минимум GPA, NIS, школьных предметов, SAT или английского не опубликован.
Meet the international citizenship rule.en: Meet the international citizenship rule and graduate from high school in time for Fall 2027. No GPA, NIS grade, subject, SAT or English-score minimum is published.

DGIST’s holistic review rewards strong M.ru: Комплексное рассмотрение DGIST учитывает сильные математические / естественно-научные оценки и технический потенциал. Официального конкурентного диапазона нет. SAT 1300–1350 и IELTS 7.0–7.5 полезны, но не обязательны и не являются порогом финансирования.
DGIST’s holistic review rewards strong M.en: DGIST’s holistic review rewards strong Math/science records and evidence of technical potential. No official competitive range is published. SAT 1300–1350 plus IELTS 7.0–7.5 can be useful but is neither required nor a funding threshold.

The public guide does not require offici.ru: Публичное руководство перечисляет загрузку документов и не требует официальной отправки College Board / IELTS. Приоритет у действующего портала и последующего запроса проверки. Сбор агентства, если отправка запрошена, оплачивается провайдеру отдельно.
The public guide does not require offici.en: The public guide does not require official College Board/IELTS agency transmission; it lists document upload. The live portal and later verification request control. Agency sending fees, if requested, are paid separately to the provider.

Optional; no minimum, superscore or curr.ru: Необязательно; минимум, superscore и текущий код отправки в руководстве не опубликованы
Optional; no minimum, superscore or curr.en: Optional; no minimum, superscore or current reporting code published in the guide

Optional if relevant to graduation/admis.ru: Необязательно, если связан с выпуском / поступлением; объяснить незнакомую систему
Optional if relevant to graduation/admis.en: Optional if relevant to graduation/admission; explain unfamiliar system

English evidence within two years under.ru: Подтверждение английского — не старше двух лет по условиям руководства
English evidence within two years under.en: English evidence within two years under guide terms

Not required for English-medium academic.ru: Не требуется для англоязычного академического пути
Not required for English-medium academic.en: Not required for English-medium academic route

No routine internal Math, Physics, Chemi.ru: Регулярный внутренний экзамен по математике, физике, химии, программированию или распределительный экзамен при поступлении не опубликован. DGIST может пригласить отдельных кандидатов на интервью; оно обязательно только для приглашённых. Формат, темы, продолжительность и вес официально не опубликованы.
No routine internal Math, Physics, Chemi.en: No routine internal Math, Physics, Chemistry, programming or placement exam is published for admission. DGIST may invite selected applicants to an interview; it is mandatory only if invited. Exact format, subjects, duration and weighting are not officially published.

**My strategy:** use one Math, CS or Phy.ru: **Стратегия — анализ:** выбрать учителя математики, CS или физики с конкретными примерами решения задач, инициативы и учебной / исследовательской работы. Контекст консультанта лучше включить в профиль школы, если он не учил или существенно не курировал вас напрямую.
**My strategy:** use one Math, CS or Phy.en: **My strategy:** use one Math, CS or Physics teacher who can give concrete evidence of problem-solving, initiative and classroom/research performance. Counselor context belongs in the school profile unless the counselor directly taught or supervised substantial work.

Academic adviser, school teacher, princi.ru: Академический консультант, школьный учитель, директор, университетский консультант или другой академический сотрудник
Academic adviser, school teacher, princi.en: Academic adviser, school teacher, principal, university counselor or other academic personnel

Direct online recommender submission; Ko.ru: Рекомендатель отправляет напрямую онлайн; корейский или английский
Direct online recommender submission; Ko.en: Direct online recommender submission; Korean or English

Name, position, affiliation, relationshi.ru: Имя, должность, организация, связь с кандидатом и контакты
Name, position, affiliation, relationshi.en: Name, position, affiliation, relationship and contact details

**Not publicly published** as of 4 Oct;.ru: **Публично не опубликованы** на 4 октября; DGIST обещает подробный порядок при открытии цикла
**Not publicly published** as of 4 Oct;.en: **Not publicly published** as of 4 Oct; DGIST says detailed process will appear when the cycle starts

Inspect the live Study in Korea form on.ru: Проверить текстовые поля действующей формы Study in Korea 2 декабря. Сейчас не выдумывать вопросы.
Inspect the live Study in Korea form on.en: Inspect the live Study in Korea form on 2 December for text boxes. Do not invent prompts now.

Not listed in the current public require.ru: Не перечислено в текущем публичном списке обязательных документов
Not listed in the current public require.en: Not listed in the current public required-document list

Scholarship consideration is not shown a.ru: Рассмотрение на стипендию не показано как отдельная заявка
Scholarship consideration is not shown a.en: Scholarship consideration is not shown as a separate application

Financial Aid and DGISTep are presented.ru: Financial Aid и DGISTep представлены как разные виды поддержки; **не** складывать ежемесячные суммы без подтверждения DGIST.
Financial Aid and DGISTep are presented.en: Financial Aid and DGISTep are presented as different support types; do **not** add both monthly figures unless DGIST confirms stacking.

DGIST international undergraduate tuitio.ru: Поддержка оплаты обучения иностранных бакалавров DGIST

Full tuition, maximum 8 semesters; curre.ru: Полное покрытие обучения, максимум 8 семестров; текущая страница не устанавливает условие GPA
Full tuition, maximum 8 semesters; curre.en: Full tuition, maximum 8 semesters; current page states no GPA condition

No separate admission form published.ru: Отдельная форма при поступлении не опубликована

KRW 328,500/month during regular semeste.ru: KRW 328 500 в месяц в обычные семестры; ≥10 кредитов, без дисциплинарного взыскания / испытательного академического статуса
KRW 328,500/month during regular semeste.en: KRW 328,500/month during regular semesters; ≥10 credits, no disciplinary/probation status

KRW 330,000/month including vacations; ≥.ru: KRW 330 000 в месяц, включая каникулы; ≥10 кредитов, без испытательного академического статуса
KRW 330,000/month including vacations; ≥.en: KRW 330,000/month including vacations; ≥10 credits, no probation

KRW 1.5m/semester; not first semester; f.ru: KRW 1.5 млн за семестр; не в первом семестре; GPA первокурсника >3.7/4.3 либо со второго курса >4.0, плюс ≥15 кредитов
KRW 1.5m/semester; not first semester; f.en: KRW 1.5m/semester; not first semester; freshman GPA >3.7/4.3 or sophomore+ >4.0 plus ≥15 credits

No additional applicant-level scheme con.ru: Дополнительная схема для поступающих не подтверждена

An exact annual gap cannot be calculated.ru: Точные годовые непокрытые расходы нельзя рассчитать: текущие официальные страницы не публикуют полную стоимость Fall 2027 (COA) или гарантированный тариф общежития. [Страница проживания](https://www.dgist.ac.kr/iuadm/sub04_03.do) подтверждает наличие общежития, но проживание оплачивается индивидуально; на проверенной странице нет гарантии всех четырёх лет.
An exact annual gap cannot be calculated.en: An exact annual gap cannot be calculated because current official admissions pages do not publish a complete Fall 2027 cost of attendance or guaranteed dorm rate. [Housing page](https://www.dgist.ac.kr/iuadm/sub04_03.do) confirms dorm availability but says accommodation is paid individually; it does not give a four-year guarantee on the reviewed page.

Full waiver up to 8 semesters.ru: Полное освобождение от оплаты до 8 семестров

Current international support page shoul.ru: При зачислении приоритет у текущей страницы международной поддержки
Current international support page shoul.en: Current international support page should control at enrolment

Exact 2027 amount/coverage TBA.ru: Точная сумма / покрытие 2027 пока не опубликованы

Accept/enrol by the offer deadline; subm.ru: Принять оффер / зачислиться в его срок; предоставить итоговый сертификат / транскрипт NIS и запрошенное DGIST заверение; при необходимости оригиналы результатов; оформить визу, финансовое подтверждение, страховку и платное общежитие; пройти подготовку приезда / ориентацию. Точные сроки диплома / апостиля, жилья и визы индивидуальны / TBA.
Accept/enrol by the offer deadline; subm.en: Accept/enrol by the offer deadline; submit final NIS certificate/transcript and authentication requested by DGIST; provide any original test evidence; arrange visa, financial proof, insurance and paid dormitory; complete arrival/orientation. Exact diploma/apostille, housing and visa dates remain offer-specific/TBA.

**Full-funding difficulty:** Closely tie.ru: **Сложность полного финансирования:** тесно связана с поступлением; обучение покрывается автоматически, но жильё / питание могут превышать выплату, поэтому пакет не равен полному COA.
**Full-funding difficulty:** Closely tie.en: **Full-funding difficulty:** Closely tied to admission; tuition is strong and automatic, but the package is not full cost of attendance because housing/meals can exceed the allowance.

**Fit:** Strong for flexible CS/AI explo.ru: **Соответствие профилю:** хорошо для гибкого изучения CS/AI и исследований.
**Fit:** Strong for flexible CS/AI explo.en: **Fit:** Strong for flexible CS/AI exploration and research.

Exact online recommendation questions; a.ru: Точные вопросы онлайн-рекомендации; эссе действующей формы; засчитывается ли NIS как необязательный национальный экзамен; официальная отправка / коды; формат интервью; срок итогового сертификата / апостиля; распределение / тариф жилья; страховка; суммируются ли виды поддержки проживания или являются альтернативами.
Exact online recommendation questions; a.en: Exact online recommendation questions; any live-form essay fields; whether NIS results count as an optional national examination; agency-report requirement/codes; interview format; final certificate/apostille deadline; exact housing allocation/rate; insurance coverage; whether living-support categories stack or are alternatives.

I am a Grade 12 applicant from Nazarbaye.ru: Я кандидат Grade 12 Назарбаев Интеллектуальной школы в Казахстане. Итоговый сертификат NIS получу в июне 2027. Можно ли подать официальное письмо об ожидаемом выпуске, текущий транскрипт и прогнозные NIS, а итоговый сертификат с апостилем после поступления? Каков точный срок итоговых документов? Можно ли представить сертификат NIS как необязательное подтверждение национального выпускного экзамена?
I am a Grade 12 applicant from Nazarbaye.en: I am a Grade 12 applicant from Nazarbayev Intellectual School in Kazakhstan. My final NIS Certificate will be issued in June 2027. May I apply with an official expected-graduation letter, current transcript and NIS predicted grades, then submit the final apostilled certificate after admission? What is the exact final-document deadline, and may the NIS Certificate be submitted as optional national school-leaving examination evidence?

Semester — late August / early September.ru: Начало семестра — конец августа / начало сентября 2027
